app-icon: App icon for Bass Fretboard Hero.
feature-graphic: Bass Fretboard Hero: Tuner, Daily Routine, Learn, Fretboard Map, Circle of Fifths and Quiz.
01-routine: Daily Routine scale exercise with note names, degrees and four-string tablature.
02-triads: Triads and their connections shown in four-string tablature.
03-pentatonic: Pentatonic positions with highlighted notes across the four-string fretboard.
04-feedback: Daily Routine highlights the next note and shows live microphone feedback.
05-quiz: Fretboard quiz with a 60-second timer, target note and score.
06-tuner: Tuner for E–A–D–G, with string selection and a pitch indicator.
07-map: Fretboard Map showing note names across all four strings.
08-circle: Interactive Circle of Fifths with relative minor keys and harmony information.
